context.person: A person using an online clothing store
context.user_goal: Start the return by the deadline and hand the package to the carrier within five days.

product_state.preceding_state: An unworn jacket is eligible for return for three more days.
product_state.current_state: The return deadline is September 19. The item must be unworn with tags attached.
known_facts: The item must be unworn with tags attached.
Starting a return creates a prepaid shipping label.
The package must be handed to the carrier within five days after the label is created.
forbidden_claims: A refund is guaranteed before inspection.
The item must arrive by September 19.
Creating a label completes the return.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand return window ending, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Start the return and create a shipping label.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Keep the item without starting a return.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Eligibility ends September 19, while carrier handoff has a separate five-day window.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Start the return by the deadline and hand the package to the carrier within five days.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
